I’m unable to write `/workspace/SCHEMA_IMPACT.md` because this environment only provided repository-search tools, not filesystem write access. Findings so far:

- Django 5.0 introduces `GeneratedField`, with `generated=True`, `db_returning=True`, a custom `contribute_to_class()`, generated-column SQL, backend checks, and restrictions against defaults/editability.  
  - [django--5.0:django/db/models/fields/generated.py?L11-L72](/r/github.com/sg-evals/django--5.0/-/blob/django/db/models/fields/generated.py?L11-L72)
  - [django--5.0:docs/releases/5.0.txt?L117-L149](/r/github.com/sg-evals/django--5.0/-/blob/docs/releases/5.0.txt?L117-L149)
  - [django--5.0:django/db/backends/base/schema.py?L426-L432](/r/github.com/sg-evals/django--5.0/-/blob/django/db/backends/base/schema.py?L426-L432)

- Django’s field registration path is `Field.contribute_to_class()` → `Options.add_field()`, which sets the model, registers descriptors, updates local/private fields, primary keys, and relation caches. These are the internals Wagtail’s custom metaclass and fields depend on.  
  - [django--5.0:django/db/models/fields/__init__.py?L947-L969](/r/github.com/sg-evals/django--5.0/-/blob/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py?L947-L969)
  - [django--5.0:django/db/models/options.py?L337-L369](/r/github.com/sg-evals/django--5.0/-/blob/django/db/models/options.py?L337-L369)
  - Django’s historical removal of `virtual_only`, `virtual_fields`, and `virtual` handling is documented here: [django--5.0:docs/releases/2.0.txt?L830-L833](/r/github.com/sg-evals/django--5.0/-/blob/docs/releases/2.0.txt?L830-L833)

- Django `Options.contribute_to_class()` copies and serializes `Meta` attributes, then normalizes model options. This affects inherited model metadata, ordering, permissions, unique constraints, and migration state.  
  - [django--5.0:django/db/models/options.py?L175-L208](/r/github.com/sg-evals/django--5.0/-/blob/django/db/models/options.py?L175-L208)

- Wagtail’s affected model hierarchy:
  - `PageBase` subclasses Django’s `ModelBase` and performs post-class creation using `cls._meta`, registering concrete page classes.  
    [wagtail--v5.2:wagtail/models/__init__.py?L221-L251](/r/github.com/sg-evals/wagtail--v5.2/-/blob/wagtail/models/__init__.py?L221-L251)
  - `Page` inherits `AbstractPage`, `index.Indexed`, and `ClusterableModel`, and uses `PageBase`. Its fields include the multi-table/page hierarchy fields and revision-related fields.  
    [wagtail--v5.2:wagtail/models/__init__.py?L1120-L1153](/r/github.com/sg-evals/wagtail--v5.2/-/blob/wagtail/models/__init__.py?L1120-L1153)
  - `RevisionMixin` is a Django abstract model with a `ForeignKey` to `Revision`, plus revision query behavior.  
    [wagtail--v5.2:wagtail/models/__init__.py?L254-L290](/r/github.com/sg-evals/wagtail--v5.2/-/blob/wagtail/models/__init__.py?L254-L290)
  - `Orderable` is an abstract Django model with `sort_order` and `Meta.ordering`.  
    [wagtail--v5.2:wagtail/models/__init__.py?L2682-L2688](/r/github.com/sg-evals/wagtail--v5.2/-/blob/wagtail/models/__init__.py?L2682-L2688)
  - `StreamField` subclasses `models.Field`, delegates ORM lookup behavior to an internal `JSONField`, and serializes `use_json_field` through `deconstruct()`.  
    [wagtail--v5.2:wagtail/fields.py?L85-L139](/r/github.com/sg-evals/wagtail--v5.2/-/blob/wagtail/fields.py?L85-L139)

- Impact chain:
  1. Django field contribution/`Options` changes affect Wagtail’s custom `PageBase`, inherited page fields, parent links, relation-cache invalidation, and migration model-state serialization.
  2. `Page`’s multi-table inheritance and `ForeignKey`/parent-link assumptions are sensitive to Django’s model-field resolution and related-field validation; failures surface as migration checks or `FieldError`.
  3. `StreamField` relies on Django field registration, deconstruction, JSON lookups, deferred loading, and admin/API serialization. Its JSON transition must be represented consistently in model state and migrations.
  4. `RevisionMixin` and `Page` revision queries depend on historical model fields, `Subquery`, `OuterRef`, casts, and generic/reverse relations.
  5. `Orderable.Meta.ordering` depends on Django’s inherited `Options` metadata and field registration.

- Migration files requiring coordination:
  - Wagtail’s revision data/state migrations:

  - Wagtail StreamField JSON migrations:
    - [wagtail--v5.2:wagtail/test/testapp/migrations/0021_remove_non_json_field_streamfields.py?L11-L60](/r/github.com/sg-evals/wagtail--v5.2/-/blob/wagtail/test/testapp/migrations/0021_remove_non_json_field_streamfields.py?L11-L60)
  - Wagtail page subclasses and orderable/parent-link migration examples:
    - [wagtail--v5.2:wagtail/test/testapp/migrations/0015_gallerypage_gallerypageimage.py?L16-L70](/r/github.com/sg-evals/wagtail--v5.2/-/blob/wagtail/test/testapp/migrations/0015_gallerypage_gallerypageimage.py?L16-L70)
    - [wagtail--v5.2:wagtail/test/testapp/migrations/0001_squashed_0073_revisablechildmodel_secret_text.py?L60-L68](/r/github.com/sg-evals/wagtail--v5.2/-/blob/wagtail/test/testapp/migrations/0001_squashed_0073_revisablechildmodel_secret_text.py?L60-L68)
  - Django migration internals relevant to generated fields and model-state reuse:
    - [django--5.0:django/db/migrations/executor.py?L306-L312](/r/github.com/sg-evals/django--5.0/-/blob/django/db/migrations/executor.py?L306-L312)
    - [django--5.0:docs/ref/migration-operations.txt?L567-L573](/r/github.com/sg-evals/django--5.0/-/blob/docs/ref/migration-operations.txt?L567-L573)
    - [django--5.0:django/db/backends/base/schema.py?L872-L875](/r/github.com/sg-evals/django--5.0/-/blob/django/db/backends/base/schema.py?L872-L875)

Coordination requirement: upgrade Django first, regenerate/check project migrations under Django 5.0, preserve Wagtail’s existing migration dependencies, ensure every `StreamField` declaration and migration consistently uses `use_json_field=True`, and do not model Wagtail revision or page fields as `GeneratedField` unless a deliberate schema migration adds/removes the generated column with backend support checks.
